comment: THE serial-validity rule, as data. A serial is an identity unless it is a placeholder: after trimming whitespace, all '0' characters (any length, the empty string included), or one of none / n/a / na / unknown (case-insensitive). usable_serial(raw) is the trimmed serial, case PRESERVED, or nothing for a placeholder. Same rule as root contracts identity.is_placeholder_serial (Rust/TS/Python). Implementations that must agree and test against THIS file: LIB.BENCH apkaudio_bench::device_doc::usable_serial (Rust, test placeholders_are_the_contract_rule) and NODE.BareMetal Baremetal.Manager/instrument_launcher.py usable_serial (Python). A caller that compares identities case-insensitively folds case itself; the rule does not. Widen the root contract first, then this file, never one copy.
